paper.title_en: TQFT gravity dual to the orbifold groupoid of Narain code CFTs over $\mathbb{Z}_4$
paper.abstract_en: In a companion paper arXiv:2610.26610, we classified the Narain CFTs obtained by gluing copies of the $A_3$ root and weight lattices along their $\mathbb{Z}_4$ discriminant group; for two hyperbolic pairs, this gives 22 even self-dual codes forming seven inequivalent theories at $c=\bar{c}=6$. Here we develop their physical interpretation and connections to 3d topological field theory. All 22 codes are topological boundary conditions of a single abelian Chern-Simons theory, whose invertible symmetries, including fractional $B$-field shifts, organize them into three orbits: free, mixed and torsion. Boundaries in different orbits are related only by gauging. We determine all gaugings of order at most four between the seven theories, by $\mathbb{Z}_2$, $\mathbb{Z}_4$ and $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$, with explicit twisted partition functions, and follow their effect on the spectrum and current algebra. We classify the topological surface operators of the bulk theory and identify those implementing these gaugings. Codes of the same group type are related by an invertible bulk surface; for different group types, every relating surface is non-invertible, and we find the minimal quantum dimension of such a surface. We give the fusion rules of the condensation defects, and show that theories self-dual under gauging carry non-invertible duality defects. Finally, we apply the TQFT gravity sum over topologies at genus one. We give a direct proof of the handlebody sum for any number of hyperbolic pairs, and closed-form weights for the handlebody and torsion contributions. For two pairs, the handlebody sum is the uniform average over the free theories and the torsion topology contributes the torsion theory, together reproducing the uniform average over all gluing codes. For three or more pairs, the handlebody sum alone is not a positive combination of code boundary states.
